Very Fun game and takes zero cash to play to experience the full content.
Great game, doesn't feel like a free game at all, so I gave them the cost of buying a full priced game in platinum. Definitely not pay to win or any of the usual nonsense of free to play games.

After a few years of dipping in and out of this game, I've really come to like it and finally took the time to get to grips with all the workings of it. Some say it's too much of grind, but I like the way it progresses. The story that is being added to the game constantly is evolving in a really great way, I'd still like to see more story and more large free roam areas to explore, but over all it's great fun especially when played with friends.

There is so much to do that even after 70 hours in I still find new features I didn't realise were there. One area I'd really like to see improved is the ability to play more story missions in a co-op mode rather than having to go into lots of missions alone, it breaks the flow a little when you've been hammering through the Corpus like a hot dakra though butter!
